paragraphs: RTVision sells configurable cloud software for managing infrastructure work. The site groups that software for transportation, government, water and utilities, and consultants. Products named on the site cover construction project management, right of way, capital improvement planning, asset management, invoice management, time and attendance, and online permits.

The construction project management product provides agencies, consultants, and contractors with access to project information from early planning through inspections and payments. The permit product automates the permit process for both the applicant and the agency, in or out of the office. Time tracking records labor, project costs, and payroll for county or city departments.

RTVision has worked since 1999 on paper-intensive management processes for its customers. Products are hosted in the cloud through Amazon Web Services, and the company states it is SOC 2 Type II certified. Case studies on the site describe county permitting, right-of-way and construction management, and capital program oversight for a regional wastewater district.

quote.text: Our mission is to advance the ability to manage, plan, construct, and maintain infrastructure through innovative software solutions.
